verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Channel3 is an API product, but no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec appears in the evidence. The probe found all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths return 404. The human-readable API reference pages and the llms.txt index are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
